name: tandem-local
description: Tandem in your AI assistant: the Tandem MCP connector plus two skills — save a work session into its project as a document, and onboard up to a first project.

interface.longDescription: Tandem is the shared memory of a customer project: people, decisions, plan, conversations, time. This plugin brings it into your assistant. sync saves a work session into its project as a document the team can read and the Tandem copilot can search; setup onboards a new user up to a first project with the sources they choose.
